I count about 12 red grapes and 1 green grape, so roughly 13 grapes in total. The plate is a square plate, probably about 24 cm across.

Each grape looks to be around 4 g, though some may be larger. That puts the total near 13 × 4.5 ≈ 58 g, so I'll use about 60 g.

Grapes have about 0.69 kcal/g, so 60 g comes to roughly 41 kcal.

There is also a small orange sliver that may be carrot, and some pink juice residue on the plate. Both are negligible.
